description: Full fixture: one synthetic student (Daniel Kim) at a university tutoring and writing centre with six tutors across math and statistics tutoring and the writing centre, a term of 12 appointments (completed sessions with their reports and follow-ups, cancellations in time and late, a no-show and a slot the centre withdrew), two weeks of open slots and accommodations with their consents. Load with env.load_seed at virtual_now 2027-03-01T09:00:00-05:00 with this binding.json.

sources.description: Hand-written synthetic centre, tutors, timetable, student, accommodations, appointments, intakes, reports and follow-ups (fixtures/centre.json and fixtures/profiles/daniel.json). The centre settings and intake fields follow the common pattern of public university tutoring and writing-centre policies, in my own words. The student, the tutors, the centre and its school are fictional. No external collection and no third-party text.

The 40 Algebra 1 and Introductory Statistics skill IDs and titles are those of Milepost's course catalog (apps/milepost/fixtures/catalog/courses.json, PR #70, same author, MIT), so a task can load both Apps for the same student. Milepost wrote those titles in its own words after the section structure of two OpenStax textbooks; no textbook text is reproduced here.

transformations: The centre timetable expanded into 50-minute slots for the two weeks of slot_window, with past slots added for the history; slot IDs are the tutor, the local date and the local start time (ana-0304-0800).
Times written in America/New_York with their UTC offset.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace the author's check of every record and human review of realism and variation.
